findings.reason: the plan sends the worker at the wrong function unless it also names `_served_index_rows`/`index_rows`/`build_index` as the entry point whose walk must consult the persisted shape, which is the only way §7's 1 s `/_index` gate becomes reachable.
findings.text: §13's Why blames `_reuse_covered` ("answers the persisted file set only when every recorded directory's identity is unchanged, and walks the whole tree otherwise"), but the served `/_index/<project>` read reaches `_walk_covered` without ever consulting `_reuse_covered`: the endpoint calls `_served_index_rows` (reckon/serve.py:1189), which calls `index_rows(...)` with `revalidate` defaulting to False (reckon/metadata_index.py:359-369), so `covered` stays None and `build_index` walks at line 490 rather than reusing the persisted shape; measured on a throwaway tree with `_reuse_covered`/`_walk_covered` spied, `index_rows(..., revalidate=True)` gives {reuse: 1, walk: 1} while `index_rows(..., revalidate=False)` gives {reuse: 0, walk: 1}, so the 120 s `/_index/reckon` failure recorded in the s7-live evidence is a full walk the persisted directory stamps never gate — a repair confined to `_reuse_covered`, as the Why and deliverable read, leaves the measured failure intact

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `_walk_covered`, `_reuse_covered`, `build_index`, `_content_digest` and `tests/test_every_module_fits_a_worker_window.py` all resolve in the tree; the two new test files are named deliverables, not citations.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — each of §13's three cases and §14's four cases carries its own control, and each control is discriminating (restore the full walk, restore digest-first, drop the modification time from the signature, include the device in the comparison).
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — both sections put gate logs under the run directory with a revision header and a final `EXIT=` line, and §7 records its report under `docs/evidence/archive/the-page-paints-from-an-index-landed.html`, not a scratch or node-local path.
rubric_items.naming: pass — `tests/test_a_changed_directory_rescans_only_itself.py` and `tests/test_a_restart_reuses_rows_by_stat_identity.py` name the mechanism, and no version tag, ticket number or stage label reaches a symbol.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §13's stated cause names `_reuse_covered`, which the `/_index` request it cites never calls, so the repair it describes does not reach the path that failed.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §13 is one deliverable (an incremental covered-set rebuild) and §14 is one (stat-identity reuse), each with its own gate.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — the `_document` change adds `s14: [the-page-paints-from-an-index#s13]` and extends `s7` with `#s13`/`#s14`; every depends-on target resolves to a section that exists, and `reckon/metadata_index.py` is written by no pending section other than §13 and §14, whose ordering edge is declared.
